description: This file provides utility functions for currency conversions and formatting related to USD and a credit system, centralizing conversion rates and string representations for a frontend application.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on a shared rate, rounding to nearest integer.

methods.name: parseUsdToNumber
methods.description: Parses various representations of USD amounts into a numeric value, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a number of credits into a string with thousands separators and 'credits' suffix.

methods.name: formatUSD
methods.description: Formats a numeric USD value into a string using a shared currency formatter, with fallback for invalid input.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Formats USD value with credits in parentheses, leveraging includeCredits support.

methods.name: renderUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Render USD with credits in a label, keeping the original value or placeholder if invalid.
